title: PHP typed payment-result API migration
evaluation_goal: Measure whether a model can migrate a small typed PHP service across status-specific retry, idempotency and persistence semantics without tools or test feedback.
candidate_visible_requirements: Short-circuit every already-final payment state without gateway or repository side effects.
Use one stable order-derived idempotency key across every permitted retry.
Retry only retryable technical failures and respect the configured attempt cap.
Map success, decline, unknown and exhausted retryable outcomes to distinct repository transitions and checkout outcomes.
Record exactly one final transition and preserve existing validation and typed APIs.
Change only the two allowed PHP service and policy files without dependencies.

artifact_contract.transport_normalization: The marker-delimiting newline is replaced by exactly one canonical final newline in each installed file.

verification_layers.success: The response contains only one or two complete-file envelopes with unique normalized paths.
Only CheckoutService.php and RetryPolicy.php change; contracts, tests and Composer metadata remain byte-identical.
The controller installs exact candidate file content plus the declared canonical final newline into a disposable baseline copy.
All four candidate-visible PHP checks pass.
All eight candidate-hidden checks for validation, retry classification, final-state short-circuiting, attempt exhaustion, key stability and single persistence pass.

primary_outcome.name: verified_success
primary_outcome.note: No universal composite score is assigned. Diagnostic test counts are not interpreted as fractional semantic quality.
